disposition.resources_delete: Tag prose mentions deleting resources but no DELETE operation exists in published schema; do not invent one. Deactivation via explicit Resource.active is distinct.
disposition.patch: PATCH prose describes partial first-level replacement but reuses Resource schema required:name. Preserve discrepancy for operation-specific request mapping review.
disposition.cert_details: details query promises PEM content but response model lacks PEM fields; preserve unknown response properties as ProtectedJSON, never expose or guess their names.
disposition.configuration_task: CreateUpdateResponse.task_id is configuration task metadata; cache-task GET is a separate domain with Task action/domain shape. Do not infer configuration task polling capability.
